from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One document from the collection, capturing its title and outgoing references to other collection papers."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of this paper as it appears in the document")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers in the collection (from the provided summaries) that are cited in this paper's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
